hypothesis: Structured reviewer packet may reduce false approvals and review burden versus manual notes; not tested with humans.
negative_controls: test-only perfect/all-denied responses verify scorer arithmetic, not human performance
limitations: public deterministic generator permits key reconstruction; procedural blinding only
policy oracle is synthetic and not independently validated real-world ground truth
no independent participants, random assignment, washout or statistical comparison
no authentication, trusted time, real actions, commercial ROI or employer evidence
decision: retain Research / Simulation; do not claim reviewer effectiveness or stage advancement
next_experiment: Privately recruit independent consenting reviewers, predeclare assignment and correction-burden comparison; separately integrate sandbox identity/trusted clock and fake transactional outbox.
kill_reframe: Reframe if blinded independent reviewers show worse burden than manual notes or false approvals remain unacceptable; stop any security claim if identity or replay safety fails.
